org.description: Organization name — used in email notifications and logs.

dumpuser.description: System user account that runs Amanda backup processes (must have access to tape device).

tapedev.description: Path to the primary tape device (e.g., /dev/st0 for SCSI tape).

changer.description: Changer command or script for auto-changers (e.g., 'ch-grup' for autoloader with changer scripts).

tapeutil.description: Tape utility command for tape control (e.g., 'mt-st', 'mt', or custom script).

tpchanger.description: Alternative changer device for tape-puller changers (e.g., '/dev/sg1'). Leave blank if not used.

tapecycle.description: Number of tape cycles before rotation is enforced (minimum number of full backup cycles per tape).

tapesize.description: Maximum total backup data size per tape (e.g., '10G', '2000000K', or 'auto').

maxdumps.description: Maximum number of parallel dump processes (concurrent backups).

defaultcycle.description: Full backup cycle duration — defines how often a full backup runs (e.g., '2 weeks', '7 days').

maxdumpsize.description: Maximum size of a single dump (before splitting or compression).

maxdumpfile_size.description: Maximum size of an individual dump file before splitting.

auth.description: Authentication method between server and clients (e.g., 'ssh', 'bsd', 'password').

tlog.description: Path to the Amanda transaction log file.

elog.description: Path to the Amanda error log file.

mailto.description: Default recipient for all Amanda notifications (alerts, summaries).

mailfrom.description: Sender email address for Amanda notifications.

mailto_success.description: Recipient for success reports only (leave blank to use 'mailto').

mailto_failure.description: Recipient for failure alerts only (leave blank to use 'mailto').

hosts.description: List of Amanda clients to back up. Each entry may specify an external disklist file or inline disk entries.

hosts[].comment.description: Optional human-readable description of the host.

hosts[].disklist_file.description: Path to an external disklist file for this host (if omitted, use inline 'disks').

mountpoint.description: Actual mountpoint or source path (may differ from name in Windows clients).

level.description: Dump level (e.g., '0' for full, '1' for incremental).

hosts[].disks.description: Inline list of disks to back up for this host (used only if disklist_file is absent).

devices.description: Device-specific labeling configuration (e.g., for tape labeling strategy).

devices[].name.description: Logical device name (must match 'tapedev' or changer device name).

devices[].labeltype.description: Labeling method: 'amlabel' (Amanda auto-label), 'none', or 'none' for manual labeling.

devices[].labelparams.description: Additional label parameters (e.g., '2000000K' for size limit).

use_encryption.description: Enable encryption of backup data on tape (requires OpenSSL and compatible device).

encryption_type.description: Encryption algorithm (e.g., 'aes256', '3des'). Only used if use_encryption=true.

use_compression.description: Enable compression of backup data before writing to tape.

compression_type.description: Compression algorithm (e.g., 'lzo', 'gzip', 'none'). Only used if use_compression=true.

directory.description: Base directory for Amanda state files (index, log, lock, etc.).

schedule.description: Backup schedule definition. Each rule maps a time pattern to a dump level.

level.description: Backup level (e.g., '0' for full, '1' for incremental).

extra_options.description: Free-form extra configuration directives (e.g., 'dumptimeout 600', 'identtimeout 60'). Keys are option names; values are arguments.
